title: Might of the Guardian
next_chapter_hook: Just when Chen Ji thought victory was assured, a bizarre golden light suddenly ignited in the empty eye sockets of the guardian puppet—its aura was identical to the fluctuations of the Tianji Record Fragment.

text.content: Dense dust surged from the depths of the secret realm, and a massive silhouette gradually emerged from the mist. It was a stone puppet standing over three zhang tall, covered in obscure ancient inscriptions, with every line glowing with an ethereal blue light, as if narrating the vicissitudes of ancient times. Embedded in its chest was a fist-sized dark gold core, each pulse triggering intense spiritual energy fluctuations—bearing the spiritual pressure only found in cultivators of the Nascent Soul Initial Stage, yet presented in a more pure and ancient manner.

A commotion arose behind them, and several following loose cultivators showed fear on their faces, their legs instinctively retreating. Nascent Soul Initial Stage! For cultivators like them at Foundation Building or Golden Core realms, this was an utterly unattainable existence. Some had already decided to retreat, quietly discussing whether to escape while the guardian puppet hadn't fully awakened. Yet Chen Ji remained motionless, his gaze tightly fixed on the puppet's dark gold core, a subtle gleam flickering in the depths of his pupils.

dialogue.content: (So that's it... The core within this guardian puppet has resonated with the Tianji Record Fragment. Interesting, what was the former master of this secret realm trying to do?)

choice.prompt: The Nascent Soul Initial Stage guardian puppet's strength far exceeded the current realm. Chen Ji had to make a crucial decision in battle strategy.

choices.description: Spend 5 Heavenly Fate points to activate the Heavenly Eye, predicting all attack trajectories of the guardian puppet, and coordinate with Ye Qing for precise strikes.
choices.risk_hint: The weak period after consuming Heavenly Fate may expose vulnerabilities

text.content: Golden light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as the Tianji Record Fragment quietly turned. He felt the world before him become incomparably clear—every flow of spiritual energy within the guardian puppet, every energy transmission through the inscriptions, all captured in his sight. After three breaths, its left shoulder would reveal a flaw—that was the weakest point where the inscriptions connected.

choices.text: Lure the Snake Out, Attrition Tactics
choices.description: Exploit the puppet's large size weakness, command everyone to move around and deplete its energy, seeking opportunities when the core becomes exposed.

text.content: Chen Ji slightly shook his head, giving Ye Qing a meaningful glance. The two needed no words to understand each other—the puppet was powerful but clumsy and slow. Using skill to overcome strength was the proper path.

The guardian puppet finally fully awakened, blue flames burning in its empty eye sockets as it let out a deafening roar. Violent spiritual pressure spread outward like a tide, and several slower-retreating loose cultivators were directly flung away, vomiting blood. Yet in this critical moment, Chen Ji acted—his figure turned into an afterimage, lunging directly for the puppet's left shoulder!

dialogue.content: (This waste... how dare he!) A flash of surprise crossed Ye Qing's mind, but her body responded faster than consciousness. Black demonic energy erupted from her palm, transforming into a three-foot sword that thrust directly toward the puppet's chest core—the direction Chen Ji had indicated with his gaze.

text.content: The coordination was seamless! Chen Ji's attack hit the inscription's weak point at precisely the right moment, and the guardian puppet's form froze abruptly. Ye Qing's demonic sword was even more precise, piercing three cun into the dark gold core. The puppet let out a pained shriek, its internal spiritual energy beginning to destabilize. Yet just as everyone thought they had succeeded, the inscriptions on the puppet's chest suddenly blazed with blinding golden light—it was forcibly activating some forbidden technique!

choice.prompt: The guardian puppet activated the forbidden technique, the battle situation took a sudden turn. A decision must be made!

choices.description: Strike simultaneously with Ye Qing, using the strongest killing move to directly destroy the core. Extremely high risk, but could determine victory in one stroke.
choices.visible_reward: One Strike, Instant Kill, Shocking the Entire Audience
choices.risk_hint: If Failed, Will Face the Backlash of the Forbidden Technique

text.content: A fierce gleam flashed in Chen Ji's eyes. The Tianji Record Fragment in his palm grew slightly warm, and a blurry image flickered through his mind—this strike was enough to end the battle.

choices.description: Lead everyone to retreat, first dodge the forbidden technique's power, then seek other vulnerabilities. Conservative but may miss the opportunity.
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Strength, Seek a Safer Timing
choices.risk_hint: The Forbidden Technique May Endanger More People

text.content: Chen Ji's brow furrowed slightly, about to order a retreat, when he saw an unwavering resolve in Ye Qing's gaze. It was a kind of... trust, willing to place her back in his hands.

Unnecessary! Chen Ji bellowed, and unknown when, a pitch-black short sword appeared in his hand. This was a secret treasure he had obtained from the Tianji Record Fragment—the Tianji Sword Embryo, never shown to others. At this moment, he poured all his spiritual power into it, and the blade blazed with dark gold light identical to the puppet's core—this was what he had comprehended from that resonance. The Demonic Path and Heavenly Dao share the same origin!

Chen Ji and Ye Qing's figures crossed in mid-air, two attacks descending simultaneously—one was a dark gold sword qi condensed with the Tianji Sword Embryo's full power, the other a pitch-black demonic sword containing the supreme mysteries of the Demonic Path. One righteous, one evil, one yang, one yin, the moment they touched the guardian puppet's core, they miraculously fused together, transforming into a black-and-white intertwined light that directly pierced through the puppet's chest!

dialogue.content: (This feeling... it's actually so compatible?) Ye Qing felt the resonance of the remaining power within her, an indescribable emotion welling up in her heart. How many secrets was this waste of a man still hiding? But she had no time to ponder, for the puppet's wail had already resounded through the entire secret realm.

text.content: The guardian puppet's body collapsed with a thunderous crash, countless inscriptions dissolving into flowing light that scattered into the void. The dark gold core floated in mid-air for a moment, then flew toward Chen Ji—more precisely, toward the Tianji Record Fragment in his embrace. Their collision produced a clear, ringing sound, and an unprecedented inscription appeared on the Fragment.

choice.prompt: Victory achieved. The core has merged with the Tianji Record. How should this priceless guardian core be handled?

choices.description: While others haven't reacted yet, quietly store the core in the Tianji Record space. Not a soul will know.
choices.visible_reward: Obtained Guardian Core, Strengthened Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: If Discovered by Ye Qing, May Affect Trust

text.content: Chen Ji calmly closed the Fragment without a trace, and the core vanished from everyone's eyes. It happened too fast, too fast for even Ye Qing to see what had occurred. She only vaguely sensed that Chen Ji's aura had become several degrees more profound in that instant.

choices.text: Show It Openly, Share the Spoils
choices.description: Display the core to everyone, expressing willingness to share this fortune with allies. Win people's hearts.

text.content: Chen Ji held the core in his palm, his expression calm as he looked at the crowd. Although the guardian core had already merged with the Tianji Record, he had long since copied a phantom image using the Tianji Record. I'll share this fortune with you all, so we may meet again someday. The crowd showed gratitude, only Ye Qing's gaze flickered, as if pondering something.

Among the ruins, Chen Ji slowly withdrew his cultivation, his face still bearing that harmless expression. Yet his heart was churning with massive waves—just moments ago, when the Tianji Record Fragment resonated with the guardian core, he had glimpsed a fragment of sealed ancient memory. That memory was too blurry, but he vaguely recalled a pair of enormous eyes, coldly gazing upon this land.

(Those eyes... somewhat similar to the Heavenly Dao's Eye described by Mo Xiansheng.) Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression remained unchanged. The guardian puppet was destroyed, and the treasure zone ahead lay wide open. Everyone cheered and rushed toward the depths. Yet Chen Ji stopped in place, his gaze deep as he stared at the pile of collapsed rubble—there, it seemed, a faint trace of dark gold light still lingered.

Ye Qing walked to his side, rarely without cold mockery. After that battle, she had entirely new recognition of this man who had seemed like waste. That tacit coordination, precise prediction, decisive judgment—none of it was what an ordinary servant disciple could achieve. For the first time, a thought crossed her mind: perhaps partnering with him truly was one of the most correct decisions of her life.

dialogue.content: Waste... no, Chen Ji. Just who are you? Ye Qing finally asked the doubt in her heart, her voice several degrees softer than usual. Chen Ji turned to look at her, the corner of his mouth slightly lifting into a meaningful smile: Who I am doesn't matter. What matters is—you and I are now on the same path.

text.content: Ye Qing was silent for a moment, then finally nodded lightly. No matter how many secrets he hid, at least in this moment, his actions had proven his worth. The pride of the Holy Sect's Demon Saint would never let her trust others easily, but Chen Ji... had already made her break precedent once. Perhaps there would be second, third times.

Just then, a violent tremor suddenly came from the depths of the secret realm. Everyone's expressions changed—the guardian puppet may have been slain, but the dangers of this secret realm clearly didn't end there. More chillingly, that tremor carried a familiar aura, identical to the previous guardian puppet, yet more concentrated, more violent. Chen Ji's pupils contracted—he felt it—beneath that pile of collapsed rubble, something seemed to be awakening. And the fluctuations within that aura had produced an unprecedentedly intense resonance with the Tianji Record Fragment!

Chen Ji subconsciously pressed his hand on the Tianji Record Fragment, feeling that increasingly intense resonance. He knew that from this moment, everything had changed—the core within the guardian puppet was no ordinary treasure, but an ancient relic of the same origin as the Tianji Record. Now that it had merged with the Fragment, it was as if opening a door long sealed shut. What truth lay behind that door? Or... even more terrifying danger?
